name: OpenRA
title: openra.net
payoff: Rebuilt classics for the modern era
shortDescription: OpenRA revitalizes classic strategy games like Red Alert, Command & Conquer, and Dune 2000 for modern computing environments. It offers enhanced graphics, updated gameplay mechanics, and full mod support. Ideal for nostalgic gamers and new players alike, OpenRA allows users to experience these classics with the benefits of contemporary technology. Users can engage in online multiplayer battles, create custom maps, or enjoy revamped single-player campaigns.
pros: Supports modern gameplay features like fog of war
Extensive modding support and community involvement
cons: Requires original game files for some features
May have a learning curve for new players
